messages:
samir: Heads-up: planning a small-region peel for **NA** — moving 5% traffic to the new edge pool in na-west2. Target window 22:30-23:15 UTC tonight. I (samir) will execute the routing policy change. @tanya you are ops lead for smoke — can you run latency and 5xx checks?

tanya: On it. What's the exact routing policy name & DNS plan? Are we changing TTL?

samir: Policy: `edge-route-v3-peel-na`. We'll update weighted routing via TrafficAPI and temporarily set DNS TTL to 30s during the window. No CNAME swaps. Runbook steps: 1) set weight 5% 2) wait 5m smoke 3) increment 25% -> 50% -> 100% with pauses. Rollback is immediate: set weight 0 and restore previous weights.

ryan: Can you paste the TrafficAPI curl? I'll wire an auto-check to PagerDuty.

samir: ```
curl -X POST https://traffic-api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/route -d '{"policy":"edge-route-v3-peel-na","weights":{"na-west2":0.05}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

ryan: thx. I'll push a small monitor that checks `200` and `p95 latency < 250ms` in the next 15m.

maya: FYI infra is running a kernel security patch that finishes at 22:15 UTC, infra-oncall will confirm. If infra not green, delay 30m.

infra-oncall: infra looks good now, all nodes show `OK` in druid. Will post if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:

tanya: Smoke checklist (I'll run and report):
- Smoke1: success rate >= 99.9% for 2 mins
- Smoke2: p95 latency under 300ms
- Smoke3: error budget < 0.1%
- Smoke4: no memory spike on edge pods
If all green I'll signal `go`.

samir: Thanks. I will pause between each increment and wait for `go`. Plan to start at 22:30 UTC. Notifying support channel and docs.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by samir for 1768123456: route-weight update (edge-route-v3-peel-na) starting 2026-02-14T22:30:00Z. Auto-rollback timer 10m after change if smoke fails.

tanya: go from me once checks pass. Will post logs: `smoke-log://peel-na/1768123456`.

ryan: pinging security for quick eyes on the TTL bump (30s). @sec-team

sec-team: Quick check done — TTL change low-risk. :ok_hand:

maya: Note: if we see new 5xxs, prefer route rollback over DNS revert since weights are immediate.

samir: Acknowledged. After 100% we'll restore TTL to 60s. I'll annotate deployment in the console.

tanya: smoke phase 1: OK, 2 minutes green, p95=220ms, errors 0.02% — ready for 25% step.

ryan: :thumbsup: pacing a small wave. I'll monitor PD alerts.

samir: Increment to 25% now.

deploy-bot: Route update applied: weights {"na-west2":0.25}. Monitor window 5m.

tanya: Phase 2: p95=240ms, errors 0.05% — still within thresholds. go for 50%.

samir: Proceeding to 50%.

deploy-bot: Route update applied: weights {"na-west2":0.5}. Monitor window 10m.

tanya: Phase 3: seeing a small uptick in DB reconnect logs, investigating. not a blocker yet.

ryan: Noticed increased retries in client telemetry; adding retry budget check.

tanya: Update: retried requests mostly in eu->na paths, looks like client affinity issue. Suggest hold at 50% for 15m and escalate if grows.

samir: Holding at 50%. @maria can you look at session affinity config? (cc @eng)

maria: On it, checking session cookie TTL and LB affinity rules.

maria: Found a misconfigured affinity timeout (30s instead of 300s) — pushing fix in 5m.

maria: Fix deployed, affinity now 300s. Recommend continue.

tanya: Re-run smoke: p95 back to 230ms, errors 0.03% — all good.

samir: Okay proceeding to 100%.

deploy-bot: Route update applied: weights {"na-west2":1.0}. Final monitor 15m.

tanya: Final: all green. Closing loop — no rollback needed. Logging post-run notes in the runbook.

samir: Huge thanks everyone. I'll push a short summary to #eng-update.
